protocol.purpose: Fixed-seed search and controller evaluation with paired uncertainty intervals and measured adapter costs.
protocol.policy: No controller, search, uncertainty-bound or service-threshold tuning using these results. Retain all seeds, no-hit runs and physically unattainable cases. These previously inspected cases use known small feeder models, not an external blind holdout.
protocol.metrics: Paired capped first-failure trials (no hit = budget+1), hit rate, measured electrical-adapter solve calls, search runtime, separately budgeted reduction and strict replay. Controller results retain all-case and initially-feasible/truth-attainable denominators. Bootstrap resamples whole paired seeds, never individual correlated trials. Intervals describe this sampling protocol, not field risk.
protocol.implementation_pin_reason: Shared replay comparator rejects non-finite values and Boolean/numeric type mismatches. Electrical models, cases, seeds, budgets, variants, tolerances and analysis settings unchanged; actual rerun under new source.

manifest.execution: Sequential fresh worker for each paired search seed and controller seed-group; process exit releases retained native contexts. Method times exclude process startup; total campaign time includes it.
manifest.cost_definition: Calls to ElectricalEngine.solve, including preconditions and intermediate states. Not native solver iterations. Only search/reduction/replay costs are metered.
manifest.interval_definition: Paired whole-seed percentile bootstrap, NumPy default_rng, 10000 draws. No independence claim for trials within a seed. No multiple-comparison correction.
limitations: New seeds on previously inspected small feeder models, not a blind external holdout.
No controller, search, service threshold or uncertainty bound was tuned using these results.
No-hit capped trial 17 is an administrative score, not an observed discovery time.
Degenerate intervals do not establish equality or safety beyond this sample.
Eligible means initially electrically feasible and service attainable within the bounded actions with privileged truth; all-case outcomes remain visible.
Timings are sequential measurements on this machine, not portable speed guarantees.
